message.content: The cover of Tempo magazine from June 2013 features a man walking out of a large, weathered, grey metal door with vertical rows of studs. The man, wearing glasses, a grey jacket over a plaid shirt, and black trousers, is smiling and looking towards the right side of the frame. He is positioned on the left side of the image, appearing to step through a doorway built into the larger metal structure. The background consists of the studded grey door, which fills most of the frame. Large red text at the top reads "TEMPO," with smaller white text above it that says "KANDIDAT GE-ER KONVENSI DEMOKRAT." To the right, bold white text reads "RAHASIA DARI BALIK PENJARA." Below this, smaller black text identifies "Priyo Budi Santoso, Wakil Ketua DPR dan politikus Golkar." In the bottom right corner, there is a barcode, the price "RP 33.000," the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO," and other publication details. A thin red border frames the entire image.
